description: public.html from the macOS general pasteboard
how: Opened file:///private/tmp/rclip-capture/page.html (h1, a paragraph with bold/italic and a link, a 3-row bordered table), used the Find bar to move focus into the page, then Edit > Select All, Edit > Copy.
notes: WebKit inlines the selection context's computed style onto every top-level element and wraps runs of spaces in <span class="Apple-converted-space">. There is no CF_HTML-style offset header: the fragment starts at byte 0, prefixed by a <head><meta charset="UTF-8"> that WebKit synthesises.
